==Description==
This template is used for creating the blue "archive box" used for closed [[Forum:Consensus track|Consensus track]] threads.

==Usage==
The template takes two parameters, of which the signature parameter is optional. If the signature is included, a reason needs to be given as well. Place only one of the following lines of code at the top of the vote page to be archived:
<pre>
{{subst:CTarchive|result of CT thread|~~~~}}
</pre>
<pre>
{{subst:CTarchive|result of CT thread}} ~~~~
</pre>

Then, to avoid disrupting the page layout, add this closing tag at the very end of the thread:
<pre>
</div>
</pre>

[[Category:Archive templates]]</noinclude>
